mestieri.restauro: Listed buildings and cultural heritage: VAT rate and reverse charge to be confirmed with your accountant.
mestieri.falegname: Custom furniture and furnishings are goods: 22% VAT even in a home. Doors and windows within work on the home follow building VAT.
mestieri.piscine: Swimming pools are not buildings: no reverse charge for cleaning and completion. Reduced VAT only if part of a renovation: to be confirmed with your accountant.
mestieri.spurghi: Drain cleaning is a service at 22%; work on the private sewer line may count as maintenance: to be confirmed with your accountant.
mestieri.giardiniere: Plants and flowers sold are at 10%: set the rate on the price list items. Masonry work in a garden may follow building VAT.
mestieri.tende: Supply and fitting only: 22%. Within maintenance or renovation work on the home: 10%. To be confirmed with your accountant.
mestieri.vetraio: Replacing window glass in a home: 10% as maintenance (to be confirmed). Mirrors and glass for furniture: 22%.
mestieri.officina: Adapting vehicles for people with disabilities: 4% (to be confirmed).
mestieri.catering: 10% for food and drink served with service (no. 121 Table A part III). Food delivery without service follows the rate of the products.
mestieri.pasticceria: Most confectionery products are at 10%: check the rate of each product.
mestieri.allestimenti: Flowers, arrangements and plants sold are at 10%; the decoration service at 22%. Set the rate on the price list items.
mestieri.noleggio: Rental follows the VAT rate of the item rented.
mestieri.musica: Live concerts are at 10% (no. 123 Table A part III); DJs and recorded music at 22%.
mestieri.organizzazioneEventi: Packages with travel and accommodation may fall under the travel agency scheme (art. 74-ter): to be confirmed with your accountant.
mestieri.stampa: Printed books and newspapers are at 4% (no. 18 Table A part II), also when you print them for a client.
mestieri.formazione: VAT exempt only if the provider and the course are recognised (art. 10, no. 20): in that case set «exempt» on the items.
mestieri.ripetizioni: Lessons on school or university subjects given personally are exempt; other lessons are at 22%.
mestieri.onoranze: Services specific to funeral homes are exempt; flowers, printing and other supplies have their own rate. To be confirmed with your accountant.
mestieri.ncc: Passenger transport: 10% (no. 127-novies Table A part III). Urban taxis are exempt.
mestieri.agricoltura: 10% only for work with farm machinery for farms; manual work and clients without an agricultural VAT number: 22%.

contesto.primaCasa: 4% VAT main home: you need the client's written statement on the requirements, and the home must not be a luxury one (A/1, A/8, A/9).
contesto.nuovaCostruzione: 10% VAT on new buildings: applies to non-luxury homes. Check the cadastral category.
contesto.barriere: 4% VAT for architectural barriers: you need a works contract and work compliant with Ministerial Decree 236/1989. Sale with fitting alone is not enough.
contesto.ristrutturazione: 10% VAT for renovation: you need the building permit (CILA, SCIA or building permit).
contesto.esterno: Gardens and outdoor areas: 22% VAT. Masonry work on an area belonging to the home may be at 10%: check with your accountant.
contesto.subappalto: Reverse charge for building subcontracts: applies if the client is a construction company or the main contractor for the job.
contesto.edificio: Reverse charge for cleaning, demolition, systems or completion: applies only if the work concerns a building.
contesto.condominio: The condominium withholds 4% as an advance: the net you receive is lower than the total.
contesto.aliquoteDiverse: Your trades have different VAT rates: lines without their own rate go at 22%. Set the rate on the price list items that have a different one.

cosa.titolo: Plenty of people can transcribe a voice note. We deal with the things that lose you money.
cosa.listinoTitolo: Your price list, as it is
cosa.listinoTesto: Upload the price list you already have: Excel, PDF, a photo of the handwritten sheet or a few old quotes. The system reads the items, units and prices, and you check and confirm. No price goes in without you seeing it. If you get stuck, we'll help you.
cosa.prezzoTesto: Plenty of apps, when they can't find an item, guess it with ‘market prices’. We don't: if it's not in your price list, we mark it as still to be priced, and you set the price. A quote that comes in too low means a job at a loss.
cosa.ivaTitolo: The right IVA, even the tricky kind
cosa.ivaTesto1: Maintenance work on a home? The 10% applies to the labour, but the beni significativi (significant goods: sanitaryware, taps and fittings, windows and doors, boilers) only count at 10% up to the value of the rest of the work. The part above that goes at 22%.
cosa.ivaTesto2: For work on a home we ask you three questions: what kind of property it is, what kind of work it is, and who buys the materials. On the PDF the 10% and 22% IVA come out split correctly, with the required wording.
cosa.ivaNota: Example taken from the Agenzia delle Entrate guide. For special cases, your accountant is always the one to ask.
cosa.lingueTitolo: You tell it in your language. Your customer reads it in theirs.
cosa.lingueTesto: Write or dictate the job in Romanian, Albanian, Arabic, Ukrainian or another language: the draft comes out in Italian. If your customer is foreign, the quote reaches them in English, with the Italian text alongside, which is the one that counts. You see the translation and correct it before you send it.
cosa.lingueDalListino: from your price list, in Italian
cosa.lingueAlCliente: to your foreign customer, with the Italian alongside
cosa.aiutoTitolo: Real help, from a real person
cosa.aiutoTesto: Logo, details, payment terms, deposits, exclusions: you set them up in a few minutes. If you get stuck, write to us or call us and a person answers, not a bot. And you send the first quote yourself, from your phone.
cosa.ultimaTitolo: The last word is always yours
cosa.ultimaTesto: The system suggests, you decide. No quote reaches your customer unless you have opened it and approved it. The new items you price go into your price list, ready for next time.

lista.d: What if it gets it wrong?
lista.r: Nothing goes to your customer without your approval. You see the uncertain items highlighted, anything not in your price list is left for you to price, and no price is ever made up.
If you can send a voice message on WhatsApp, you can use it. It opens in your phone's browser, there's nothing to install, and if you get stuck a real person will answer.
Exactly: we only use yours. You upload your price list as it is, even as a photo or from old quotes, and anything that isn't in it is left for you to price until you decide.

A general-purpose assistant doesn't know your price list, so it guesses the prices. It doesn't split the IVA (Italian VAT) using the "beni significativi" (significant goods) rules, it doesn't make a PDF with your logo and it doesn't collect your customer's yes.

lista.d: Is it right for my trade?
lista.r: If you quote item by item, yes. Home and installations: electricians, plumbers, painters, bricklayers, window and door fitters, metalworkers, gardeners. Cars: repair shops, body shops, tyre shops. Events: photographers, caterers, event set-ups, music. Businesses and people: IT technicians, graphic designers, printing, training, private lessons, beauty. It finds your trade's words in your price list. With the pilot we'll also measure it on trades we haven't tried yet.

lista.d: Can I tell it in my own language? What if my customer is foreign?
lista.r: Yes. Write or dictate the job in Romanian, Albanian, Arabic, Ukrainian, Spanish or another language, and the draft comes out in Italian with the prices from your price list. For voice it depends on your phone: if your language isn't available, type it. And if your customer is foreign, you send them the quote in English: you check the translation, and the Italian text stays alongside and is the one that counts.

lista.d: I talk fast, there's noise, I use my own words.
lista.r: The system knows the items in your price list and the names you use. If a measurement isn't clear, it asks you again instead of guessing.
The PDF prints like any other quote. With the link, though, your customer accepts in a minute, with no sign-up, and you have proof of what they accepted.

lista.d: Where do my voice messages and my customers' data end up?
lista.r: Your price list and quotes are kept on servers in the European Union. To prepare the draft, the text of your description goes through an artificial intelligence service, named on the [Privacy page](/privacy). Only the text reaches our servers, not the audio, and we sign a data processing agreement with you for your customers' data.

lista.d: Do I have to change my invoicing software?
lista.r: No, keep yours. Preventivi takes care of quotes; invoices stay where they are.

blocchi.testo: This page explains what personal data Preventivi handles, why, where it goes and how long it stays.
Who handles your data
The data controller is Sofiane Khatib, K Digital Solution. For any request about your data, write to [{email}](mailto:{email}).

For the data of a tradesperson's customers (names, job site addresses, quotes), the data controller is the tradesperson. We handle it on their behalf, as data processor, under the agreement we sign with them.
What data, why and for how long
If you apply for the pilot programme

voci: Name, trade, town, mobile number and, if you tell us, how many quotes you do each week.
We only use it to call you back and see if the pilot is right for you (legal basis: your request and your consent).
If you don't join the pilot, we delete it within 12 months. You can ask us to do it sooner at any time.

blocchi.testo: If you use the tradespeople area

voci: Login email, the business details you enter (company name, partita IVA (Italian VAT number), address, phone, IBAN if you give it), logo, price list and quotes.
If you upload your price list from a PDF, a photo or old quotes, the artificial intelligence only reads the price items. Customer names are not copied and the file is not kept.
We need it to provide the service (legal basis: the contract, even during the free pilot).
It stays for as long as you use the service. When you stop, we delete it within 30 days, except what the law requires us to keep (for example invoices, 10 years).

blocchi.testo: If you are a tradesperson's customer and you open their quote

voci: When you accept or decline a quote, we record the name you type, the date and time, your IP address and the fingerprint of the PDF.
The tradesperson needs this as proof of acceptance. We keep it on their behalf, for as long as they use the service.
To see, correct or delete this data, you can contact the tradesperson or us. We will pass your request on to them.

blocchi.testo: If you try Preventivi with an example or on WhatsApp

voci: The text you write, the draft it produces and, on WhatsApp, the number you write from.
Test drafts delete themselves after 7 days. On WhatsApp, a draft waiting for your reply stays for one hour at most.
For tests, don't write data about real people. Made-up jobs are enough.
To limit abuse, we keep a fingerprint (hash) of the IP address, not the address itself.

blocchi.testo: Who we share it with
We use these providers, each one only for its own part:

voci: Supabase: database, login to the area and PDF storage, in Ireland (EU).
Vercel: the website and its functions, in Frankfurt (EU).
Anthropic (Claude): reads the site visit text and prepares the draft, and translates the quote items when the customer speaks another language, in the United States.
Twilio and WhatsApp (Meta): receive and send the WhatsApp messages.
n8n: connects the WhatsApp messages to Preventivi.
Resend: sends the emails with the login code.

blocchi.testo: When data leaves the European Union, we rely on the safeguards set out in the GDPR: the EU-US Data Privacy Framework certification or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. We don't sell data, and we don't use it for advertising or to train artificial intelligence models.
Your rights

You can ask us to show you your data, correct it, delete it, limit its use, object to its processing or give it to you in a readable format. You can also withdraw your consent whenever you want. Write to the address above and we will reply within 30 days. You can also complain to the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (the Italian data protection authority, garanteprivacy.it).

Preventivi is a service by Sofiane Khatib, K Digital Solution. It helps tradespeople, businesses and professionals of every trade prepare quotes: from your account of the job, it prepares a draft with the prices from the business's price list. The business checks it, approves it and sends it to the customer. The service is only for businesses and professionals with a partita IVA (Italian VAT number).
Pilot programme

voci: Ten places, assigned by us after a phone call.
30 days free from the start, with unlimited quotes. You upload the price list (Excel, PDF or photo). If you need it, we help you.
No automatic renewal: at the end of the 30 days, you decide whether to stay. If you tell us nothing, the pilot just ends.
In return, we ask you to use it on your real jobs and to tell us what works and what doesn't.

blocchi.testo: After the pilot

voci: Fee: €19.90 a month or €199 a year, plus IVA, with unlimited quotes. No setup fee.
You can cancel the monthly plan whenever you want, and it ends when the month you've already paid for is over. The yearly plan lasts 12 months and only renews if you ask for it.
If we change our prices, we'll tell you at least 30 days before, and the new prices only apply from the next renewal.

blocchi.testo: You decide the quote

voci: Preventivi suggests, you decide: no quote goes to your customer unless you have opened and approved it. Before you approve, check the items, quantities and prices.
Prices come only from your price list. Items that aren't in it stay “to be priced” (da prezzare), and you add the price yourself.
The IVA calculation follows the answers you give and the rules of the Agenzia delle Entrate (the Italian tax authority), but it isn't tax advice: for special cases, ask your accountant.
Your relationship with the customer, your prices and your jobs stay yours: Preventivi is not a party to the contract between you and your customer.

blocchi.testo: Your data stays yours

voci: Your price list, your quotes and your business details are yours. If you ask, we'll send you your price list in Excel and your quotes as PDFs.
We handle your customers' data on your behalf, under the data processing agreement we sign when you start. How we handle other data is explained on the Privacy page.
Don't enter health data or other special categories of data about your customers: you don't need them for a quote.

blocchi.testo: What we guarantee and what we don't

voci: We do our best to make sure the service always works without errors, but it can misread your description of the job. That's why you must check every draft before you approve it.
There can be interruptions for maintenance or because of problems with our suppliers. We'll tell you in advance about any major maintenance.

Within the limits of the law, and except in cases of wilful misconduct or gross negligence, our liability does not go beyond what you have paid us in the last 12 months. During the free pilot, the service is provided as it is.

blocchi.testo: Fair use

Use Preventivi only for your own business's quotes. Don't share your login with people outside your business, and don't use the service to upload offensive text or bulk requests. If these rules aren't followed, we can suspend your access, after warning you.
Changes and governing law

If we change these terms, we'll tell you by email at least 30 days before. Italian law applies and, for disputes, the court that has jurisdiction under the law. If you have any questions, write to [{email}](mailto:{email}).

Preventivi only uses technical cookies: without them, the tradespeople area wouldn't know you're logged in and the site wouldn't remember the language you chose. No profiling cookies, no statistics, no third-party tools that follow you from one site to another. That's why you won't see a cookie banner.

voci: **kds-sessione**: keeps you logged in to the tradespeople area, which you enter from your K Digital Solution account (the same for all its tools). The account sets it when you log in; it works on all kdigitalsolution.it addresses, lasts 30 days from your last visit and is deleted when you log out.
**pl_lingua**: remembers the language of the site. We set it when you pick a language with the selector or when you open a page in a language other than Italian, and it lasts one year.

blocchi.testo: The fonts and flags are served by the site itself, not by outside servers. If we ever need another cookie, this page will say which one it is, what it's for and how long it lasts, and if it isn't technical, we'll ask you first.

prova.h1: From your description to a draft
prova.testo: The engine picks out the jobs, matches them to your price list and prepares a draft for you to check. Prices come only from your price list: what it can't find stays to be priced, and if something is missing, it asks you.
prova.nota: The data here is made up: the price list's business and the customers in the examples don't exist. Don't enter names, addresses or numbers of real people: drafts are kept for 7 days and anyone with the link can open them. Free text is processed by an artificial intelligence service.
